correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the exact 12-point two-ring metric from gap classes with squared lengths (t+2-sqrt(3),1,t+2,3,t+2+sqrt(3),4); six ordering walls follow algebraically for all t>0, including ties. Inspected the 13-state clique/homotopy atlas and free-relative-collapse checks of 12,24,60 pairs, cap-annulus pushouts and integral primitive images. Independently enumerated all clique complexes and computed mod-two persistent barcodes at eleven generic and wall samples; every independent interval agreed with the stated formulas. The infinite t statement uses the symbolic affine threshold order, not inference from those samples. Integral primitivity is established by the identified annulus/cap inclusion maps and integer cancellation in supplied verified computations, rather than inferred solely from mod-two ranks.
